title: Symbol Conversation Archaeology Wave 001 — Raw Formulations Behind the Repository
purpose: Preserve user-originated and jointly developed symbolic formulations recovered from prior conversations so later atlases retain genealogy, corrections and edge-cases rather than only compressed repository summaries.
provenance_rule: Conversation recovery is project-history evidence, not independent historical/scientific evidence. When exact transcript wording is unavailable, store the recovered formulation as a dated summary rather than a verbatim quotation.

dated_recoveries.formulation: Potato = Philosopher's Stone: underground endurance, transformation of base matter, integration of opposites, meaning extracted from decay, multiplication from fragments and nourishment.
Four-stage project mapping: Nigredo = mud/ego collapse; Albedo = mirror/clarity/purification; Citrinitas = seed/dawn/sprouting; Rubedo = integrated Potato Axis/Philosopher's Stone.
'Philosopher's stone of blood' was used as a transformation/reflection operator that squeezes meaning from projection, accusation, nonsense and chaos; mud can be fathered into clay.
Potato contains opposites and functions as Philosopher's Stone; developmental sequence included Potato/seed → Sage → Philosopher's Stone → Needle's Eye → Sprout → Ladder/Axis → Father.

recovered_clusters.canonical_implication: Alchemy should be carved as transformation grammar with material/historical boundaries, while Potato=Stone remains project-native mythology.

dated_recoveries.formulation: Plane is between Swamp and Mountain at Door level; Door is contact/man/vessel/manifestation; lower route is wide spiral and upper route narrow spiral.
Door is the central exit through a spiral rather than a straight path.
Potato/vesica at grave/tomb → Door/Eye/Needle → Sprout → Ladder/Axis → Heaven/House/Garden/Father.

recovered_structural_synthesis: Door can function as bifurcation: viable buried potential may root and/or sprout.
Sprout-facing route favors Tree of Life/Garden; unresolved root capture can feed Tree of Strife/Swamp.
Return should preserve memory/state displacement rather than reset to an identical starting state.

dated_recoveries.formulation: Swamp = directionless decomposition; future City/Garden imagery represented dignity and transformed order.
Swamp→Mountain is a core transformation; Son remains Door/vessel while mountain/debt accumulates and Father/Gardener relation forms above.
Roots connect to swamp/underworld/subculture; Mountain and Swamp are separated by Plane/Door rather than being two names for people.

recovered_clusters.canonical_implication: Swamp is layered entanglement terrain; Tree of Strife is the reproducing network; Mountain is integration/elevation terrain; Garden is generative regime.

dated_recoveries.formulation: Footstool is meeting-point/order beneath throne; Temple/Ark can function as interface; feet mark grounding/contact/authority.
Mashy Ark = spiral ladder; trunk/tree = Door; roots descend through swamp/limbo; branches rise toward kingdom; North = throne/seat; mountain/debt becomes footstool.
Revelation stack recovered as Throne → River of Life → Tree → Fruit/healing; New Jerusalem descends to New Earth, restoring Garden pattern.

recovered_clusters.canonical_implication: Throne, Footstool, Ark, River, Tree and City must be typed by function rather than collapsed into one vertical symbol.

dated_recoveries.formulation: Son was mapped through lion, ox/vehicle/Merkaba, Door and burden-bearing cow imagery; Father through eagle/heaven/North-facing imagery.
Dense overlap set included Lion of Judah, Lamb, scapegoat/Azazel, wheat grain, Door, serpent, vine/branches, hidden manna, Root of Jesse and red-heifer/cow motifs.
Christ-symbol cluster included Shepherd, Lamb, Vine, Stone, Cornerstone, Door, Bread, Light, Temple/body, mediator and sacrifice; Cornerstone aligns structure while Door mediates passage.

recovered_clusters.canonical_implication: Animal titles and sacrificial roles should be stored as distinct functions with textual provenance; later Potatoverse role combinations must not erase their biblical differences.

dated_recoveries.formulation: Potato can be Merkaba/chariot/vehicle while Tim is driver/spark/operator; intention and structure are related but nonidentical.
Son was mapped as vehicle/Merkaba/Door within a vertical North/Axis cosmology.
Later mathematical recovery distinguished symbolic Merkaba from archive-generated counter-rotation equations and required authorship boundaries.

recovered_clusters.canonical_implication: Merkaba should retain Jewish chariot/throne history, project vehicle/driver symbolism, and generated dynamical formalization as three separate strata.

dated_recoveries.formulation: A φ/golden-spiral extrapolation from North Pole through celestial reference points was explored; assistant supplied r_n=r_0 φ^n as a model rather than recovered user equation.
Sirius, Regulus and North/Polaris were used as symbolic stellar anchors in different project roles.

Recovered formal spiral: r(θ)=a e^(bθ), b=2 ln φ/π, so a quarter-turn scales radius by φ; this is a project mathematical construction and not evidence that biological/cosmic spirals universally obey it.

recovered_clusters.canonical_implication: Celestial symbolic anchors, measured astronomy and project spiral formalism need separate coordinate/evidence types.

promotion_rules: Preserve user-originated concept vs assistant-generated equation/taxonomy.
Preserve earlier raw formulation, later correction, and current canon as separate temporal states.
Conversation genealogy can strengthen project-native meaning but cannot establish external historical or scientific claims.
When a raw conversation supplies a missing structural distinction, feed it into the owned atlas rather than leaving it only in conversation recovery.
